title: Separate running from enabled at boot
goal: Verify startup policy with a controlled guest reboot.
challenge: Enable ll-boot.service for multi-user startup, reboot only the guest, and verify a start from the new boot. Finish with the unit stopped and disabled. Explain how the current boot differs from disk Resume and RAM restoration.

steps.command: systemctl get-default; systemctl is-enabled ll-boot.service; sudo systemctl start ll-boot.service
steps.explanation: Read the target and demonstrate a manually started but disabled unit. Do not change the default target.
steps.expected: Normal target remains unchanged; unit starts despite disabled policy.

steps.command: sudo systemctl enable ll-boot.service; systemctl is-enabled ll-boot.service; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
steps.explanation: Record the boot ID and enable link. Enable alone is not proof of a successful future start.
Reboot only inside the native guest console. Wait for automatic learner login. No shell variables/jobs survive.
steps.expected: A fresh guest boot with the same disk files.

steps.command: cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; sudo cat /var/lib/ll-boot/last-start; sudo journalctl -b -u ll-boot.service -n 12 --no-pager
steps.explanation: Match last-start to the new boot ID and inspect current-boot events. The worker may have reached its runtime limit by now.
steps.expected: New boot ID; LAB_READY from this boot establishes startup, even if it later expired.

steps.command: sudo systemctl disable --now ll-boot.service; systemctl is-enabled ll-boot.service; systemctl is-active ll-boot.service
steps.explanation: Restore dormant startup policy. Do not disable unrelated guest services.

hints: Start affects now; enable changes startup links.
Use journalctl -b and the marker boot ID, not a stale status screenshot.
Reboot and disk Resume preserve files but not old processes or shell variables.
review: I matched successful startup to a new boot.
coverage: Partial LPIC-2 202.1; LPIC-1 101.3 controlled reboot (partial). Guest-only administration; completion records self-review, not verified assessment. No score.
